response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), shares AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, 1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM district_counts), ranked AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference FROM shares) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, difference FROM ranked ORDER BY difference DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted mean across districts that have at least one account; districts with no accounts are excluded because they do not appear in account.district_id counts.
